fields.title: Buwan Ng Wika: Lingua Narrative Celebration 2026
fields.author: South East Asia Aesthetic
fields.paragraph_1:
Buwan ng Wika is a celebration of the diverse cultures and languages of the Philippines. Let’s celebrate and recognize talented developers from across the world through rich, narrative-driven games and localized titles that embrace the spirit of “Lingua Franca.”

Buwan ng Wika: Lingua Narrative Celebration 2026 is a Steam event hosted by SEAGamethetic, featuring games with localization and a strong focus on narrative elements.

The event will run from August 11 to 16 2026.

fields.name: Tools & Servers
fields.description: Welcome to the Tools and Servers hub! This dedicated space is for players and creators to share, discover, and discuss external resources that enhance the gameplay experience. Here, you can find and promote community-run multiplayer servers, recruit players for your custom realms, and share useful third-party tools like stat trackers, calculators, mods, and companion apps. Whether you are a server host looking for players or a gamer seeking the best utilities to optimize your play, this is your central directory.

fields.name: Game Forum
fields.description: A game forum is an online community hub where players gather to discuss every aspect of a specific video game. In this space, the player base connects to share effective gameplay strategies, debate recent patch updates, and troubleshoot technical bugs or connection issues. It also serves as a vibrant social platform where users showcase creative fan art, recruit teammates for guilds, and bond over their shared passion for the game.

fields.name: GameGame Forum
fields.description: Welcome to the GameGame Forum, the official community space built entirely for our platform and its players! This is your direct line to the development team, where your voice matters most and helps shape the future of our gaming ecosystem. We invite you to share your innovative feature requests, provide constructive feedback on platform performance, and submit creative suggestions to improve the user experience. Join the conversation today, vote on ideas from fellow gamers, and collaborate with us to build the ultimate gaming platform together!

fields.title: Add the "AI Generated" tag
fields.content:
Please, like there is a tag for "Action" games, there also should be a "AI generated" tag.

I don't wanna waste my time scrolling trough a pile of ai slop """games""" on every steam event
I don't wanna see them be pumped trough my recommended or my own queue or even what people are playing feed.
I don't wanna support them at all, even with a single dollar because i did not scrolled all the way down to see that indeed it was ai sloop and i gave money to someone that did nothing at all.

Let us choose if we want or not want to be bombarded with ai sloop and black list it or not.

fields.title: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA
fields.description:
◆ Intense 4 VS 4 Team Battle
Enter the world of Dragon Ball by bringing your favorite characters' earth-shaking strength to the battlefield, and join up with your friends and allies to defeat your opponents and dominate the objectives.
Grow your strength throughout each round, unlock game-changing attacks and abilities, and obliterate enemy players and bosses alike.

◆ Heroes With Roles
Pick heroes with unique abilities and skills to fulfill strategic roles for your team:
- DAMAGE: Simple but effective, super aggressive play style with a focus to take down the enemy
- TANK: Persistent and hard to K.O., help your team hold the field and soak up the enemy's attacks
- TECHNICAL: Versatile support, maximize your team's chances by boosting your allies and disrupting the enemy.

◆ Customization
Personalize your favorite heroes in your own style with character skins, entrance animations, and special finisher animations.
Find an aesthetic combination that shows off your love for the characters in your own way.
fields.short_description: DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA is Dragon Ball's first team-oriented free to play game.
